activity_summary: You said you had been told and not asked. The wash is fourpence a week and already paid. You said there would be no answer today.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it, and did not go to the pen.

facets.activity: Said Anne had set the wash, and named the fourpence

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Told, not asked. Fourpence the week, and already paid.
